dashboard.label: Multi-Vendor Secure Branch - Security Detections
dashboard.description: FortiGate HQ and Sysmon telemetry mapped to MITRE ATT&CK

panel.title: T1190 - SQL Injection blocked by FortiGate IPS

search.query: index=network type=utm subtype=ips attack="*SQL*" | stats count, values(action) as action, values(attack) as attack, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by srcip, dstip, dstport | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)

panel.title: T1046 - Port Scan (denied connections to the firewall)

search.query: index=network type=traffic subtype=local action=deny | bin _time span=5m | stats dc(dstport) as ports, count as denied_attempts by _time, srcip, dstip | where ports>=15 | sort - _time

panel.title: T1110 - Brute Force: HTTP sessions to WEB-DMZ by source

search.query: index=network type=traffic subtype=forward dstport=80 | timechart span=10m count by srcip

panel.title: Sysmon telemetry by host (DC01 and BR-WIN11)

search.query: index=sysmon | timechart span=1h count by host
